locator.section: Postcommunio above Tuesday heading; accented nostrum through Deus.

entries.claim: The separate Postcommunion prints accented nostrum through Deus., with no comma after Christum, colon and uppercase Qui after tuum. Only this middle excerpt is used, not its proper body or an ending absent from this page.

locator.section: Top chant line before Nativity Preface dialogue; Per omnia and responsive Amen

entries.claim: The top chant line prints Per omnia saecula saeculorum and responsive Amen. Only these five words are borrowed; syllable divisions joined, response marker/music omitted. This is the Secret/Preface transition, not a direct printing of the II Postcommunion response speaker.

RG115a supplies the complete Father-addressed Per Dominum conclusion, including qui tecum, Deus, duration and Amen. It controls expansion content, not the accented composite transcript or its accidental seams.

locator.section: Rubricae generales511h/i,512,513a; oration and Preface delivery

entries.claim: RG511h/i assigns clear voice to the Preface and Postcommunion in low Mass; RG512 defines quiet delivery, and RG513a assigns sung orations and the Per omnia transition in solemn Mass. This controls delivery, not a direct printing of the Postcommunion terminal response speaker.

locator.section: Ritus servandusVII7–8; Secret excludes the intelligible Preface beginning Per omnia

entries.claim: RitusVII8 ends the quiet Secret before Per omnia, which begins the intelligible Preface. VII7 priest Amen follows Suscipiat before the Secret, not its terminal response.
